home.title: AI GTM systems that start at the decision
home.description: Amoris is a founder-led AI GTM practice. Evidence-led account research and reasoning for B2B teams, built on LangGraph. The research layer runs today; the outbound reasoning layer is in private testing.
home.hero-chip: Evidence-led GTM research, with a system that can say HOLD
home.hero-title: More GTM activity won't fix a bad decision
home.hero-sub-slogan: Most go-to-market problems get treated as volume problems. They are usually decision problems - which accounts, which motion, what to say. Amoris starts there, then builds the system around it.
home.references: A decade of finding patterns, designing systems and driving revenue
